description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions related to challenges in the FreeCodeCamp project, including saving and updating user challenge data, and managing challenge IDs for different challenge types.

methods.name: saveUserChallengeData
methods.description: Saves or updates a user's challenge data in the savedChallenges array, updating lastSavedDate and challenge files.

methods.name: updateUserChallengeData
methods.description: Updates a user's challenge data in the database, handling challenge completion, saving progress, and challenge metadata.
